questions.question: Define the term 'derived demand' as it applies to labour. (2 marks)

A worker adds 6 units of output an hour, each unit sells for $5, and the wage is $25 an hour. The firm can sell any amount at this price. Calculate the value of the worker's extra output per hour and state whether a profit-maximising firm would employ the worker. (2 marks)
Explain two factors that influence the elasticity of supply of labour to an occupation. (4 marks)
Analyse the likely effects of a net inflow of migrant workers on the equilibrium wage and employment in an occupation. (6 marks)
Evaluate the view that wage rates are determined only by the demand for and supply of labour. (20 marks)
Examine the likely effects on employment of a trade union negotiating a wage above the equilibrium wage. (8 marks)
Discuss the likely consequences of geographical and occupational immobility of labour for an economy. (14 marks)
